Confirmed by Jack Heart (2026-11-12): "I think the latest, at or before half the training hours, is nice". Keep the at-or-before option on Earlier/Fraction. The frontier's case is on training hours, which today is not a recorded checkpoint clock (manabot rebases `Checkpoint.wall_ms` per run); the docs example should show the run recording an hours clock (or name what it uses), and not invent an Etude-derived clock.
